title: NAVIGATING DATASET DOCUMENTATIONS IN AI: A LARGE-SCALE ANALYSIS OF DATASET CARDS ON HUGGING FACE

bias_targets.methodology: Applying Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) topic modeling to the 'Discussion of Biases' subsection of Hugging Face dataset cards to identify and evaluate how frequently practitioners document demographic representation issues (e.g., gender, race, age imbalances) in their datasets.

Applying Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) topic modeling to dataset documentation to extract and categorize practitioner-reported biases that stem from data curation, keyword selection, and human annotation procedures.
